source_evidence.title: Modelamiento hidraulico de la quebrada San Antonio de Pedregal para estimar zonas de inundacion ante huaycos, Lurigancho Lima 2019

reported_conditions: destroyed dike documented during field survey
population exposed near lower ravine and Rimac outlet

accepted: independent hydraulic plausibility reference for Pedregal/San Antonio
comparison of modeled flood extent with and without mitigation
field evidence of degraded or damaged control structures
forbidden: treat model-derived discharges as observed gauge values
treat modeled flood extents as observed 2015 outcome footprints
treat proposed dikes or retaining walls as verified as-built infrastructure
derive or transfer operational alert thresholds
use this source to unblind target outcomes or negative controls
use outcome evidence to rerank or replace preregistered controls

single_remaining_research_closeout_gate.requirement: Complete and freeze the clean-room negative-control adjudication package and its independent safe-unblind step without outcome leakage, candidate reranking, or reuse of contaminated adjudication evidence.
single_remaining_research_closeout_gate.why_this_is_the_remaining_gate: Hydraulic mechanism, topographic context, rainfall-frequency context and modeled flood response are now sufficiently supported for research validation. The remaining scientific weakness is outcome discrimination against independently adjudicated non-impact controls under the preregistered Chosica 2015 design.
not_required_for_research_closeout: as-built verification of every modeled mitigation structure
